Name: Identify
Purpose: Identifies by username or email without revealing whether the account exists, which is the setting an enumeration test checks

Name: Password
Purpose: Three attempts then the flow cancels; the lockout a brute-force test should hit

Name: Second-Factor
Purpose: Validates a second factor when the user has one and skips when not, which is exactly the gap an MFA coverage report exists to find

Name: Consent
Purpose: Consent that expires after four weeks, so a re-prompt is a state and not a bug

Name: Log-In
Purpose: An eight-hour session; the value a session-lifetime audit reads

Name: Refuse
Settings: deny_message=Contractors cannot enrol through this link.
Purpose: A stage that only denies, for the enrolment flow that must admit nobody
